slots.name: broadcast date
slots.sentence: Clinical psychologist Dr. Sheryl Ziegler and educator Jackson Katz join "CBS Mornings" to answer parents' questions about how to talk to their kids about consent in the wake of the investigation into an alleged gang rape at a fraternity house at Cornell University in 2024.
